_about: TODO-35 (PLAN.Physics.CsUnderCo60, DA-1 ... DA-12), validation phase: Cs-137 under Co-60 at the hand-held head, 1 m source-detector (S = 1000 - D, the gate's convention). Scenes in angular elements (atan(cell / D) = 1.042 deg): co-located, two elements apart (Cs -1, Co +1) and five (Cs -2.5, Co +2.5). Co-60 activities 0, 0.1, 1, 3, 10, 100 MBq plus the activity giving 10 uSv/h H*(10) at the head (ICRP 74, computed). Windows on the event's total deposit (7 % FWHM at 662 keV, sqrt(E)): cs662, the product reference 'side' 727.87-860.21 keV (DA-7), co1332 and coBoth 1055.88-1465.75 keV as comparisons; every window also through gain errors -2, -1, +1, +2 %. Validation (seeds disjoint from the selection): Z_s with the pinned per-configuration thresholds csco-thresholds-v1.json on 64 Cs-free nulls per configuration (false-trusted rate, raw-window PR-SENS-02 gate counter-case from gate-thresholds-v2.json, case head1m, where a threshold exists); count mode per reference window (exact and normal Currie limits, 1000 two-window acquisitions at 0, 0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2 x the exact L_D, three decision rules, gain errors); imaging with Cs-137 at 100 ... 4000 counts (200 acquisitions each); Cs-free residual acquisitions with delta R, gain errors, a global R and R_i calibrated at Co-60's direction (ideal field, 200 each).
